# AI Integration

AI suggestions are generated by `/api/ai/suggestions` and consumed via `useAISuggestions()`.

## Setup

```env
OPENAI_API_KEY=
ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=
```

If no keys are set, mock suggestions are used.

## Key Files

- `src/lib/ai/llmService.ts`
- `src/lib/hooks/useAISuggestions.ts`
- `src/components/AI/AISuggestionsPanel.tsx`
- `src/app/api/ai/suggestions/route.ts`

## Usage

```tsx
'use client'
import { useAISuggestions } from '@/lib/hooks/useAISuggestions'
import { AISuggestionsPanel } from '@/components'

const { suggestions, loading, error, generateSuggestions } = useAISuggestions()

<AISuggestionsPanel
  suggestions={suggestions}
  loading={loading}
  error={error}
  onApplySuggestion={handleApplySuggestion}
/>
```

  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT NOW()

-- Enable RLS
ALTER TABLE ai_insights ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;

CREATE POLICY "Users can view their own insights"
  ON ai_insights FOR SELECT
  USING (auth.uid() = profile_id);

## Costs

### OpenAI (gpt-4-turbo-preview)
- ~$0.01-0.03 per request
- 2000 token limit = ~500 workouts analyzed
- Monthly cost for typical user: $1-5

### Anthropic (claude-3-opus)
- ~$0.015-0.075 per request
- More expensive but often better reasoning
- Monthly cost: $2-8

### Recommendation
Start with OpenAI gpt-4-turbo-preview for cost-effectiveness, then upgrade to Claude Opus for power users who want deeper insights.
